name: growlytics-ai-system
description: Growlytics AI — Your AI Co-Pilot for Smarter E-commerce Growth

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix api run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix api run db:push
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
